app.name: Marketplace
app.summary: Connector catalog, provider accounts, consent-gated tool execution and an owner approvals queue for a Teal Brick workspace.
app.domain: connectors, provider accounts, agent consents, consented tool calls, owner approvals

operations.summary: List the calling agent's active connector consents (ids, toolkit, actions, state; never credentials)
Run one consented connector action for the calling agent; the consent must belong to the caller
List the channels the calling agent has a consent for: label, purpose, audience, effective capabilities, caps, usage today and own standing grants
One consented channel; 404 for channels without consent (same as unknown)
Upload raw attachment bytes (query name, content-type header) for a later post; returns attachmentId and sha256. Not outward
Post to a consented channel: 200 receipt under a covering standing grant or an owner-approved digest, otherwise 202 approval_pending (strict contract body; post id in the Tealbrick-Post-Id header)

Schedule a post (sendAt now+60 s to now+30 days); authority is checked and the digest bound now, then rechecked at send time; a held schedule answers 202 approval_pending with the post id in the Tealbrick-Post-Id header
Cancel one of the caller's own scheduled posts (narrowing; never needs approval)
The caller's own channel receipts
The caller's own standing grants and their state
Propose a standing grant (proposed; authorises nothing until the owner approves); never wider than the channel ceiling
Narrow one of the caller's grants; any widening is refused
Withdraw one of the caller's grants
Inbound messages the owner routed to the caller (newest first, untrusted external text with its source ids); the fallback for agents without the Buzz bridge

Reply natively in the source thread of an inbound event routed to the caller (outward consent for that channel required): 200 receipt under a covering standing grant or an owner-approved digest, otherwise 202 approval_pending
Forward the owner-signed decision {approvalId, proof} (Buzz nostr event or Portal owner assertion) for the caller's own held call; single-shot per approval
Start a Portal consent request for an agent connector action
Redeem an approved Portal consent into a stored consent (idempotent by request id)
Revoke a stored agent consent or grant
Connect a provider account for a connector (provider connect)
Install a connector for the workspace
Uninstall a connector from the workspace
Register an installed connector with the runtime
Unregister a connector from the runtime
Import a provider toolkit into the workspace catalog
Read provider settings (secret presence only)
Update provider settings
Remove the stored provider key
List held connector calls waiting for owner approval
Read one held connector call
Approve a held connector call
Deny a held connector call
The owner's Buzz approval key: fingerprint, trust source and status only (never the key)
Set or change the owner's Buzz approval key (owner launch session only); invalidates holds made under the old key
Clear the owner's Buzz approval key (owner launch session only); invalidates holds made under it
Channels, provider readiness, connections (bot identity only), pending grants and uncertain posts
Destinations the provider credential can reach
Create a channel from a discovered destination with its policy ceiling
Change a channel or its ceiling; bumps revision and re-checks standing grants
Pause a channel (suspends its standing grants)
Resume a paused channel
Archive a channel (soft; receipts remain)
Send the fixed test text after the owner clicks; returns the receipt
Approve a standing grant as proposed or narrowed
Decline a proposed standing grant
Revoke a standing grant, effective immediately
Scheduled, held and uncertain channel posts (filter by status and channel) with send time, agent and digest prefix
Cancel a scheduled post; also closes its waiting or approved approval
Mark an uncertain post sent or failed after checking the destination
Export channel receipts with their text (retention domain record)
Purge receipts older than the retention (default 90 days)
Turn inbound on or off for a channel and pick the agent that receives it (default off); Telegram sets or deletes the bot webhook, Discord starts or stops the gateway
Recent inbound events (metadata, route outcome and at most 500 characters of the untrusted text each) and the receiver status
Inbound text retention (1-365 days, default 30) and the Discord Message Content intent (privileged, default off)

fields.label: Composio API key
fields.description: Account-level key for the Composio connector provider. Taken from the account connection and delivered to this service as an environment variable.

fields.label: Composio API address
fields.description: Leave empty for the default Composio API.

fields.label: Default provider user
fields.description: User id Marketplace uses when a connection names none.

fields.label: Telegram bot token
fields.description: Token of the Telegram bot that agents post through. Taken from the account connection and delivered to this service as an environment variable. Create the bot with @BotFather.

fields.label: Discord bot token
fields.description: Token of the Discord bot that agents post through. Taken from the account connection and delivered to this service as an environment variable.

fields.label: Slack bot token
fields.description: Bot token (xoxb-) of the internal Slack app that agents post through. Create the app in your workspace from the Marketplace manifest, install it, then copy the Bot User OAuth Token. Delivered to this service as an environment variable.

fields.label: Slack signing secret
fields.description: Optional. Signing secret of the same Slack app (Basic Information), used to verify messages that Slack sends to Marketplace. Not needed to post.

fields.label: Microsoft Teams bot app ID
fields.description: Microsoft App ID of the single-tenant Azure Bot that agents post through (a GUID). Taken from the account connection and delivered to this service as an environment variable. Setup: docs/channels-teams-setup.md.

fields.label: Microsoft Teams bot client secret
fields.description: Client secret of the bot's Microsoft Entra app registration. Taken from the account connection and delivered to this service as an environment variable.

fields.label: Microsoft Teams tenant ID
fields.description: Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra tenant where the single-tenant bot is registered (a GUID).

fields.label: Microsoft Teams person lookup (optional)
fields.description: Reserved for a later version: agents cannot find people or start 1:1 chats yet. Leave it empty and do not grant User.Read.All for it now.

oneOf.description: 202 approval_pending, exactly the contract approvalPendingSchema (strict). The post id is in the Tealbrick-Post-Id response header.
